name: Crag Coyote Fang
summary: A Crag Coyote Fang comes from coyotes in the Badlands. Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath needs ten for his alchemical supplies.

sections.title: A Badlands Reagent
sections.body: Jarkal Mossmeld, an alchemist in Kargath, asks for Crag Coyote Fangs to replenish his stocks. The fangs come from Crag Coyotes, Elder Crag Coyotes, Feral Crag Coyotes, and Rabid Crag Coyotes in the Badlands. He needs ten, along with buzzard gizzards and rock elemental shards.

faq.q: Where do Crag Coyote Fangs come from?
faq.answer: Crag Coyote Fangs come from Crag Coyotes, Elder Crag Coyotes, Feral Crag Coyotes, and Rabid Crag Coyotes in the Badlands.
Jarkal Mossmeld, an alchemist in Kargath, asks for ten Crag Coyote Fangs to replenish his stocks.

faq.q: Why does Jarkal need the fangs?
faq.answer: Jarkal Mossmeld needs Crag Coyote Fangs as reagents to replenish his alchemical stocks.

faq.q: What else does Jarkal ask for?
faq.answer: Jarkal also asks for five Buzzard Gizzards and five Rock Elemental Shards.
